remarks: Location, Location, Location! Freshly painted and filled with natural light, this downtown Stamford apartment offers beautiful city views from a private 7th-floor balcony. Originally a studio, it has been thoughtfully redesigned with a partition wall to create the feel of a separate bedroom with its own window. Features include hardwood floors, an updated bath with a new vanity, two large closets, and a custom-remodeled kitchen with new stainless steel appliances, a hidden refrigerator/freezer, and a movable island. Enjoy the convenience of walking to restaurants, shopping, theaters, the library, and the Metro-North train station. Building amenities include a fitness center, on-site laundry, and beautifully maintained park-like grounds. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy the best of downtown Stamford living-schedule your tour today!
